props.text: April Was The Worst Month In Crypto Approval-Drainer History. The Most Common Output Of An Agent That Watches Your Wallet Is A NOOP.
A single-month record was set in April 2026 for approval-drainer losses. The meta-attack that grew alongside it is lookalike revoke sites that drain users following correct security advice.

For an individual holder whose security team is wallet-risk-weekly and vigil-revoke instead of a SOC: most Mondays the watcher posts nothing, the most common output of a panic-dispatched revoke is NOOP (already zero), and the agent cannot be phished by a fake revoke site because the agent has no browser. The shift is in who gets to have a security team at all.
